title: Viral Reload EX

sections.title: About What Comes After
text: Viral Reload EX is a shoot-em-up with a dash mechanic where you shrink down to fight infections at a microscopic scale! Can you defeat the evil Kyle Kaboom before he destroys the moon?

In the year 2063 the evil Kyle Kaboom has begun kidnapping the former members of his band Chainsaw Cannonball and infecting them with deadly viruses! Strapped into the Viral Unit, Bimmy and Octo must fight these infections all while trying to track down Kyle and stop him before he destroys the moon!
Blast away at deadly viruses and mechanical hybrids as you fight for the future of mankind! Dash through bullets, lasers, and even enemies to stay alive and rack up points.

Silver Bullet is a thrilling throwback that blends tight, old-school gallery shooting with modern smoothness and melee parries. It’s pure arcade joy that’s simple, challenging, and delightfully repayable.

Silver Bullet’s aesthetic is dark, cartoony, and full of Halloween charm. But beneath its playful premise of a pint-sized Van Helsing rescuing puppies from the forces of darkness lies a razor-blade-stuffed apple – an arcade game with a wicked edge.

A personal journey towards self-love with easy-to-learn gameplay, offering plenty of ideas and new perspectives…
